description: This file contains an abstract class implementation of the CommandResponse interface, providing common behavior for command response objects within the package. It manages response type, status code, headers, and JSON serialization logic.

classes.name: AbstractCommandResponse
classes.description: An abstract class implementing CommandResponse, encapsulating common response properties such as response type, status code, headers, and JSON serialization.

methods.name: AbstractCommandResponse
methods.description: Constructor initializing the response type, status code, and headers, with null checks.

methods.name: getStatusCode
methods.description: Returns the HTTP status code associated with the response.

methods.name: getDittoHeaders
methods.description: Returns the headers associated with the response.

methods.name: getManifest
methods.description: Returns the response type, used as a manifest identifier.

methods.name: appendPayload
methods.description: Abstract method for subclasses to append custom payload data to the JSON object.

methods.name: toJson
methods.description: Serializes the response to a JSON object, including common fields and subclass-specific payload.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Checks equality based on headers, status code, and response type.

methods.name: canEqual
methods.description: Type check method for equals implementation.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Computes hash code based on headers, status code, and response type.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: String representation of the response object.
